test_title: PYST 32: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 28 Feb, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose ‘No improvement’ as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

The deer __eat all__ the lettuce in the garden.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The sentence is in the past tense, so the verb should also be in the past tense.
 
• "Eat" is the present tense form of the verb, which is incorrect in this context.
 
• The correct past tense form of "eat" is** "ate".**
 
• Thus, "ate all the lettuce" is the correct phrase.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The deer **ate **all the lettuce in the garden."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Option 2: "had eat all"** – This is grammatically incorrect because "eat" should be in the past participle form "eaten".
 
• **Option 3: "eaten all"** – This is incorrect without an auxiliary verb like "have" or "had" before it.
 
• **Option 4: No improvement** – This is incorrect because "eat" is in the present tense.
